subcommands.apply: Apply a configuration to a resource by file or stdin
subcommands.cp: Copy files and directories to and from containers
subcommands.create: Create a resource from a file or stdin
subcommands.describe: Show details of a specific resource or group of resources
subcommands.drain: Drain node in preparation for maintenance
subcommands.edit: Edit a resource on the server
subcommands.exec: Execute a command in a container
subcommands.expose: Expose a resource as a new Kubernetes service
subcommands.logs: Print the logs for a container in a pod
subcommands.port-forward: Forward one or more local ports to a pod
subcommands.rollout: Manage the rollout of a resource
subcommands.run: Run a particular image on the cluster
subcommands.scale: Set a new size for a deployment, replica set, or replication controller
subcommands.version: Print the client and server version information
